title: Bram and the Wreck
author: Marguerite Blackwood
blurb: Juniper Brightwater, a railroad engineer with a map of closed lines, carries a compass, a debt, and very little else. Then the river gives up a chest stamped with a dead nation's seal — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now he must follow a river upstream to its forbidden source, and time is already running out.
style: wry first-person narration with emotional depth
